description: Across the harbour at Brielle, a brick city gate with one arch sits in front of the grass rampart, and the tall brick tower of the Sint-Catharijnekerk rises behind it. The sky is overcast, about 14.6°C, with wind near 9.0 km/h and no rain. Sunset was 19:32. A few boats are moored without readable names. The quay is empty.
